# SCI-POINT v0.1 Stage A Change Log

## `2026-09-02` — Initial recovery-first packet

- created the canonical SCI-POINT package structure;
- preserved the owner's package split and explicit no-reinvention direction;
- recovered frozen predecessor boundaries, historical SRC/MODE inventory,
  current Pointing fit/products, TolTECA correction construction, TolProj
  workflow use, and validation/status evidence;
- separated scientific authority from implementation and evidence;
- established a working-wheel adoption register;
- proposed narrow POINT-FIT and per-array measurement roles;
- kept cross-array aggregation and correction construction unresolved;
- separated MAP, JINC, FLT-FIXED, FLT-MATCHED, and FRUIT candidate parents;
- recorded nine bounded owner questions; and
- reserved Stage B source/PDF paths without drafting normative content.

No algorithm, frozen package, implementation, validation, performance,
readiness, production, or Unity state changed.

## `2026-09-02` — ODQ-001 approval

- recorded the owner's approval that SCI-POINT v0.1 ends at authoritative
  per-array measurements;
- assigned all cross-array aggregation to the named pointing-support producer;
- required the downstream aggregate to preserve complete member, weighting,
  covariance/dependence, partial-array, failure, method, and provenance state;
  and
- preserved ODQ-002 through ODQ-009 as open.

## `2026-09-02` — ODQ-002 approval

- recorded the owner's approval that POINT publishes measured displacement
  only;
- assigned cross-array aggregation, correction sign, telescope user/paddle-
  offset composition, selection, native support, and correction-record
  publication to the named pointing-support producer;
- preserved SCI-AST authority for correction interpretation/application; and
- kept every specific downstream aggregation and correction method
  unapproved, with ODQ-003 through ODQ-009 open.

## `2026-09-02` — ODQ-003A/003B direction

- removed FRUIT as a separate candidate POINT parent family;
- required a terminal FRUIT result to retain its exact MAP, JINC, FLT-FIXED,
  or FLT-MATCHED map type plus complete FRUIT terminal/generation lineage;
- excluded coadd parents and intermediate FRUIT iterations from base v0.1; and
- preserved the MAP/JINC/FLT observation-local admission choice as the
  remaining ODQ-003 question.

## `2026-09-02` — ODQ-003 approval

- recorded the owner's approval of MAP, JINC, FLT-FIXED, and FLT-MATCHED as
  distinct eligible observation-local POINT parent families;
- prohibited automatic route selection, substitution, equivalence, and
  fallback;
- kept exact predecessor numerical availability and POINT compatibility
  binding as separate gates; and
- preserved FRUIT as terminal-map lineage and coadds outside base v0.1.

## `2026-09-02` — ODQ-004 approval

- adopted the established six-parameter elliptical-Gaussian fit as
  `POINT-FIT/ELLIPTICAL-GAUSSIAN-COMPATIBILITY@1`;
- kept the existing method subject to complete scientist-readable Stage B
  description rather than numerical redesign or implementation copying;
- excluded additional profile families from base v0.1; and
- preserved ODQ-005 through ODQ-009 as open.

## `2026-09-02` — ODQ-005 approval

- preserved the mature configurable expected-center/central-search,
  weighted-peak initialization, global fallback, bounded fit domain, and
  amplitude/width/angle constraint machinery;
- required separate requested, effective, and realized values or named states;
- made fallback realization and numeric-sentinel resolution explicit; and
- preserved ODQ-006 through ODQ-009 as open.

## `2026-09-02` — ODQ-006 approval

- made every requested observation-array-parent-method fit independently
  atomic;
- required complete, diagnostic-only, or unavailable state with an honest
  affected-use/reason record;
- prohibited sibling-result erasure, missing-array synthesis, and POINT-owned
  whole-observation success; and
- retained downstream ownership of any partial-array aggregation policy while
  preserving ODQ-007 through ODQ-009 as open.

## `2026-09-02` — ODQ-007 approval

- required the established marginal formal parameter errors when available
  with honest method, assumption, domain, conditioning, and limitation state;
- permitted full joint parameter covariance to be unavailable without
  invalidating the fit;
- prohibited interpreting missing covariance as zero, diagonal covariance, or
  independence; and
- retained later covariance, astrometric, empirical, or NOI estimates as
  separately versioned companions while preserving ODQ-008 and ODQ-009 as
  open.

## `2026-09-02` — ODQ-008 approval and QC refinement

- made fitted amplitude, widths, and angle required components of every
  numerical compatibility fit result;
- authorized those parameters, centroid, and honest fit state as telescope
  and observing-condition quality-control metrics;
- preserved exact processed-map unit, calibration, response, support,
  constraint, and uncertainty meanings;
- prohibited silent promotion to universal flux, intrinsic beam, SCI-BEAM
  authority, or unique physical-cause attribution; and
- preserved ODQ-009 as the final open owner decision.

## `2026-09-02` — ODQ-009 approval and decision-set closure

- separated fit completeness, pointing-support displacement,
  telescope/observing QC, and CAL/TolProj amplitude policy ownership;
- required independent use-specific outcomes and made diagnostic-only an
  explicit use-specific state rather than a universal bad flag;
- preserved VAL as registry/evaluator rather than policy author;
- assigned exact collision-free profile mechanics to Stage B subject to final
  owner approval and prohibited a base-v0.1 aggregate profile; and
- closed the bounded ODQ-001 through ODQ-009 owner-decision walkthrough while
  leaving Stage B blocked pending sanitized-packet repair, content binding, and
  explicit dispatch approval.
